title: PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents
title_zh: PhoneCLI: 从 App 接口到可调用命令的移动代理

paragraphs.en: Mobile GUI agents operate through a perception–action loop: at each step they screenshot the device, invoke a vision–language model (VLM), and emit an action. It is slow, costly, and brittle, yet most of what it does is navigation—and everyday navigation is static, ordered, and endlessly repeated. We present PhoneCLI, which compiles an app’s GUI navigation into callable commands, without any app-internal API, runtime instrumentation, or model training. Offline, PhoneCLI explores a target app from the outside and distills its screens, interactive elements, and navigation edges into a semantically annotated map; each screen yields one deterministic command: a replay sequence that reaches it. Online, the agent selects a command, verifies it before execution, and then executes it deterministically in sub-second time at zero VLM cost; open-ended interaction and every failure of the compiled path fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter, exactly the pure VLM agent, so compilation can only help. On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves the task success rate while reducing steps and token consumption, and it transfers to AndroidWorld’s official M3A agent with consistent efficiency gains. What PhoneCLI compiles is the app’s navigation rather than one run, so it serves new tasks, not only repeated ones.

paragraphs.en: GUI agents for mobile devices largely operate through a perception–action loop: at each step, the agent captures the screen, invokes a vision–language model (VLM) to reason over the visual information, and emits an action at either the index level or in coordinate form. The agent’s competence is acquired through training on GUI corpora and/or via fine-tuning and reinforcement learning [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . This paradigm is confronted with three compounding challenges.

sents.en: This paradigm is confronted with three compounding challenges.
sents.zh: 这种模式面临着三个相互叠加的挑战。

paragraphs.en: (I) Closedness. Desktop computer-using agents can operate via rich programmatic surfaces— e.g. , CLI tools, APIs, or even executable code [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] —because the desktop ecosystem provides open interfaces. By contrast, mobile apps offer no comparable privilege. They function as black boxes with no client-side, third-party programmatic interface, and even modern mobile frameworks typically only allow composition with system-level commands [ 8 ] , leaving the internal state and logic of each app inaccessible. Consequently, the agent is restricted to a screenshot-based loop, which is slow (on the order of seconds per step), costly (requiring one API call per step), and brittle, often leading to hallucinated coordinates and navigation failures.
paragraphs.zh: （I）封闭性。 使用台式计算机的智能体可以通过丰富的程序化接口进行操作——例如，命令行工具、API 甚至可执行代码 [5, 6, 7]——因为桌面生态系统提供了开放的接口。 相比之下，移动应用则没有类似的权限。 它们如同黑箱一般运行，没有任何客户端的第三方程序化接口；即便是现代化的移动框架，通常也只允许与系统级命令进行组合 [8]，导致每个应用的内部状态和逻辑都无法访问。 因此，智能体只能依赖基于截图的循环操作，这种方式既缓慢（每一步需要数秒），又成本高昂（每一步都需要一次 API 调用），而且不够稳定，常常导致坐标幻觉和导航失败。

paragraphs.en: (II) Repetitiveness. Nevertheless, the navigation induced by the loop targets interfaces whose structure is largely known a priori. Everyday mobile app usage is highly repetitive and follows consistent, ordered patterns [ 9 , 10 ] : for instance, opening a settings page, selecting a tab, and locating a specific item. Such behavior typically traces a small set of static paths repeatedly. Unlike free-form interaction, the navigation structure can therefore be enumerated offline. This motivates the core idea of this work: pre-build the repeated navigation once and replay it deterministically thereafter.
paragraphs.zh: (II) 重复性。 然而，由循环引导的导航所针对的界面，其结构在很大程度上是事先已知的。 日常移动应用的使用具有高度重复性，并遵循一致、有序的模式 [9, 10]：例如，打开设置页面、选择选项卡以及查找特定项目。 此类行为通常反复遵循少数几条静态路径。 与自由形式的交互不同，因此导航结构可以离线枚举。 这启发了一项工作的核心思想：预先构建重复的导航流程，并在之后以确定性方式重演该流程。

paragraphs.en: (III) Generalization. The alternative route—training—stores capability in the model weights. However, each new app typically requires additional data collection and/or re-training, which exposes a major bottleneck studied in recent work on RL generalization [ 11 ] and on adaptation to previously unseen apps [ 12 ] . Re-training is both costly and inflexible: a model that has never encountered an app has no direct shortcut for navigating it. Given the scale of modern app stores, with millions of apps, per-app training is infeasible in principle.
paragraphs.zh: (III) 泛化。 另一种方法——训练——将能力存储于模型权重中。 然而，每个新应用通常需要额外的数据收集和/或重新训练，这暴露出了一个主要瓶颈，该问题已在近期关于强化学习泛化 [ 11 ] 以及适应此前未见过的应用 [ 12 ] 的研究中被探讨。 重新训练既昂贵又缺乏灵活性：一个从未接触过某个应用的模型，没有直接快捷的方法可以操作该应用。 考虑到现代应用商店的规模（包含数百万个应用），为每个应用单独进行训练在原则上是不可行的。

paragraphs.en: Existing remedies either improve the loop from within—by pairing stronger VLMs with grounding and memory scaffolding [ 13 , 14 ] —or incur the training cost to sharpen the agent [ 2 ] . However, neither approach eliminates the repeated navigation bottleneck itself. We propose PhoneCLI , which takes a third route: compile an app’s GUI navigation into callable commands . Offline , PhoneCLI explores each target app once from the outside, without any app-internal API and without instrumentation. It distills the app’s screens, UI elements, and navigation edges into a structured map, and compiles each screen into a deterministic command— i.e. , a replayable action sequence that reliably reaches that screen. This offline procedure does not involve training or model updates, so integrating a new app takes only minutes. Online , the agent maps each task to a command, verifies the selection, and replays it deterministically in sub-second time with zero VLM calls. Only open-ended interactions not covered by the command table are handled by the VLM, which serves as a graceful fallback.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的解决方案要么从内部改进这一循环——通过将更强大的 VLM 与基础知识和记忆框架相结合 [ 13 , 14 ] —要么需要付出训练成本来增强智能体 [ 2 ] 。 然而，这两种方法都无法消除重复导航这一瓶颈本身。 我们提出了 PhoneCLI，它采取第三种路线：将应用程序的 GUI 导航编译为可调用的命令。 在离线状态下，PhoneCLI 从外部对每个目标应用程序进行一次探索，无需任何应用内部的 API 或植入式工具。 它将应用程序的屏幕、UI 元素和导航边界提炼为结构化地图，并将每个屏幕编译为确定性命令——即一个可重放的行动序列，能够可靠地到达该屏幕。 这一离线过程不涉及训练或模型更新，因此集成新应用只需几分钟。 在线状态下，智能体将每个任务映射为一个命令，验证选择结果，并以亚秒级的时间以确定性方式重放该命令，且无需任何 VLM 调用。 只有命令表中未涵盖的开放-ended 交互才会由 VLM 处理，而 VLM 在此时充当一个优雅的备用方案。

paragraphs.en: Recent work shares parts of this picture. PreAct [ 15 ] compiles agent trajectories online to replay the same task. UI-KOBE [ 16 ] enables runtime following of an explored UI graph. Trajectory-mining approaches recycle explored paths back into the VLM as textual hints [ 17 , 18 ] , meaning that reuse still incurs perception costs. PhoneCLI differs along the decisive axis: it compiles offline, at the granularity of navigation commands, and then executes them deterministically. As a result, the compiled knowledge supports unseen tasks rather than only repeated ones, and its reuse requires no perception at runtime. In short, PreAct compiles what an agent has done, whereas PhoneCLI compiles what the app is. We discuss our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究部分呈现了这一图景。 PreAct [ 15 ] 在线编译智能体轨迹，以重演同一任务。 UI-KOBE [ 16 ] 支持在运行时跟踪已探索的 UI 图。 轨迹挖掘方法将已探索的路径作为文本提示重新利用到 VLM 中 [ 17 , 18 ]，这意味着重复使用仍需产生感知成本。 PhoneCLI 在关键维度上有所不同：它离线编译导航命令级别的细节，然后以确定性方式执行这些命令。 因此，编译后的知识能够支持未见过的任务，而不仅仅是重复的任务，并且其重复使用在运行时无需任何感知。 简而言之，PreAct 编译的是智能体已经执行的操作，而 PhoneCLI 编译的是应用程序本身具备的特性。 我们将讨论我们的三个方面的贡献：

paragraphs.en: GUI-to-CLI compilation. We present a compilation pipeline that transforms a black-box app—lacking any app-internal API, instrumentation, and training—into a structured app map and a catalog of deterministic callable commands, one per screen. This pipeline provides the agent with a programmatic surface that the app itself does not expose, enabling new apps to be integrated within minutes without any model update.

paragraphs.en: Reliable command invocation. We design an invocation mechanism based on two-phase routing that selects and verifies a command prior to execution. Deterministic replay places the agent in the target screen in sub-second time at zero VLM cost, while any failure falls back gracefully to the embedded VLM interpreter. By removing the most frequently repeated aspect of mobile app usage—navigation—from the VLM loop, PhoneCLI preserves the performance of its backbone without degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的命令调用。 我们设计了一种基于两阶段路由的调用机制，在执行命令前会先选择并验证该命令。 确定性重播可在不到一秒的时间内将智能体置于目标屏幕中，且无需任何 VLM 成本；若出现任何故障，则会优雅地回退到嵌入式 VLM 解释器。 通过将移动应用使用中最频繁重复的部分——导航——从 VLM 循环中移除，PhoneCLI 在性能不受影响的前提下保留了其核心架构的性能。

paragraphs.en: Motivation and design rationale. As detailed in Section 1 , our design rests on three observations: (I) closedness , mobile apps expose no programmatic surface, unlike the CLI tools and APIs available on desktop, which confines mobile agents to a slow, costly, and brittle screenshot-perception loop; (II) repetitiveness , everyday app usage is highly repetitive and ordered, and the navigation skeleton that connects screens changes far more slowly than app content, so a path distilled once is replayed many times; and (III) generalization , training-based agents are prone to distribution shift on unseen apps and costly to re-train, whereas on-demand exploration integrates a new app in minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 动机与设计原理。 如第 1 节所述，我们的设计基于三个观察：(I) 封闭性——与桌面端可用的命令行工具和 API 不同，移动应用没有暴露任何程序接口，这使得移动智能体只能陷入缓慢、昂贵且脆弱的逐帧截图感知循环；(II) 重复性——日常应用使用高度重复且有序，连接各屏幕的导航框架比应用内容变化得慢得多，因此一旦提炼出的路径会被多次复用；以及 (III) 泛化性——基于训练的智能体在面对未见过的应用时容易出现分布偏移，且重新训练成本高昂，而按需探索方法则能在几分钟内将新应用整合进来。

paragraphs.en: This motivates our central design principle: build once what is static, and handle on the fly what is not . Navigation is static, frequent, and pre-enumerable, so we distill it offline into a table of callable commands and reuse it across tasks; open-ended interaction—form filling, dynamic content, unexpected dialogs—is variable and cannot be exhaustively enumerated, so it is handled by the VLM at runtime. Such content—feeds, recommendations, merchant lists—changes on every load; the navigation skeleton does not, and only the skeleton is compiled. We refer to the offline distillation as compilation and to the runtime handling as interpretation —a division of labor analogous to mixed-mode execution in programming languages, where frequently used code is compiled ahead of time and the remainder is interpreted on demand. paragraphs.en: Design properties. (I) Compile once, reuse many. The offline cost is amortized across all subsequent tasks and runs, and navigation no longer consumes the VLM budget. (II) Guaranteed floor. Every failure path—no matching command, a rejected verification, or a landing mismatch—resolves to the pure VLM agent, so the success rate is never below that of the VLM-only baseline; what the compiled path adds is a bounded number of routing calls, not a new failure mode. (III) Model-agnostic knowledge acquisition. The command table is constructed without training or model updates; a new app is integrated in minutes by re-running the offline stage.
paragraphs.zh: 设计特性。 (I) 一次编译，多次复用。 离线成本会分摊到所有后续任务和运行中，导航也不再消耗 VLM 预算。(II) 保底保障。 每一条失败路径——无论是没有匹配的命令、验证被拒绝，还是着陆不匹配——都会最终回退到纯 VLM 智能体，因此成功率绝不会低于仅使用 VLM 的基线方案；编译路径所增加的内容只是有限数量的路由调用，而非一种新的失败模式。 (III) 模型无关的知识获取。 命令表无需训练或模型更新即可构建；通过重新运行离线阶段，新应用可在几分钟内完成集成。

sents.en: Design properties.
sents.zh: 设计特性。

sents.en: (I) Compile once, reuse many.
sents.zh: (I) 一次编译，多次复用。

sents.en: The offline cost is amortized across all subsequent tasks and runs, and navigation no longer consumes the VLM budget. (II) Guaranteed floor.
sents.zh: 离线成本会分摊到所有后续任务和运行中，导航也不再消耗 VLM 预算。(II) 保底保障。

sents.en: Every failure path—no matching command, a rejected verification, or a landing mismatch—resolves to the pure VLM agent, so the success rate is never below that of the VLM-only baseline; what the compiled path adds is a bounded number of routing calls, not a new failure mode.
sents.zh: 每一条失败路径——无论是没有匹配的命令、验证被拒绝，还是着陆不匹配——都会最终回退到纯 VLM 智能体，因此成功率绝不会低于仅使用 VLM 的基线方案；编译路径所增加的内容只是有限数量的路由调用，而非一种新的失败模式。

sents.en: (III) Model-agnostic knowledge acquisition.
sents.zh: (III) 模型无关的知识获取。

sents.en: The command table is constructed without training or model updates; a new app is integrated in minutes by re-running the offline stage.
sents.zh: 命令表无需训练或模型更新即可构建；通过重新运行离线阶段，新应用可在几分钟内完成集成。

paragraphs.en: The first stage constructs the app map 𝒢 = ( S , E , λ , M ) \mathcal{G}=(S,E,\lambda,M) from a black-box app in two steps: structural exploration recovers the app’s navigation skeleton, and semantic enrichment renders that skeleton interpretable to a language model. Our exploration inherits systematic UI traversal from Android testing crawlers [ 21 , 22 ] , but targets reusable navigation rather than test coverage. Unlike trajectory-based methods that inject mined knowledge back into the VLM as text [ 17 , 18 ] , the explored structure is compiled into deterministic, executable commands.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段通过两个步骤从黑盒应用中构建应用地图 𝒢 = ( S , E , λ , M ) \mathcal{G}=(S,E,\lambda,M)：结构探索恢复应用的导航骨架，而语义增强则使该骨架对语言模型具有可解释性。 我们的探索方法继承了 Android 测试爬虫的系统化 UI 遍历策略 [ 21 , 22 ]，但目标是可重用的导航路径，而非测试覆盖度。 与将挖掘出的知识以文本形式注入 VLM 的轨迹基方法不同 [ 17 , 18 ]，我们探索出的结构被编译为确定性的、可执行的命令。

paragraphs.en: Structural exploration. Starting from a clean launch state, the crawler traverses the app in breadth-first order. At each screen it reads the UI hierarchy, records the interactive elements it finds, activates them one by one, and observes the screens they reach, thereby assembling the screens, elements, and navigation edges of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . Scrollable screens are explored over multiple scroll pages so that content below the fold is not omitted. The walk is bounded by depth and screen budgets chosen to cover the navigation core of typical apps. Screen deduplication is computed from raw elements before semantic annotation, so that persistent bottom navigation bars shared across tabs do not dominate the signature and collapse distinct tabs into a single screen.
paragraphs.zh: 结构探索。 从干净的启动状态开始，爬虫以广度优先的顺序遍历应用程序。 在每个屏幕上，它读取 UI 层次结构，记录找到的交互式元素，逐个激活它们，并观察它们所到达的屏幕，从而构建 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 的屏幕、元素和导航边。 可滚动的屏幕会跨越多个滚动页面进行探索，以确保折叠区域以下的内容不会被遗漏。 遍历过程受深度和屏幕预算的限制，这些参数经过选择，以覆盖典型应用程序的核心导航部分。 屏幕去重是在语义标注之前基于原始元素计算的，这样跨标签页共享的持久底部导航栏就不会主导特征描述，也不会将不同的标签页合并为单个屏幕。

paragraphs.en: Semantic enrichment. The raw graph captures syntax—text and coordinates—but not semantics: what an element is, or what a screen is for. Because both routing (Stage 2) and verification depend on semantic understanding, a language model annotates the graph. Each element is classified as STABLE (present across app versions) or DYNAMIC ; assigned aliases with a semantic type ( button , input , label , etc.); and each screen is given a natural language description.
paragraphs.zh: 语义增强。 原始图捕获了语法——文本和坐标——但并未捕捉语义：即某个元素是什么，或某个屏幕的用途是什么。 由于路由（阶段 2）和验证都依赖语义理解，因此需要使用语言模型对图进行标注。 每个元素被分类为稳定的（STABLE，即在不同应用版本中均存在）或动态的（DYNAMIC）；被分配带有语义类型的别名（按钮、输入框、标签等）；并且每个屏幕都会被赋予一个自然语言描述。

paragraphs.en: Compilation to commands. From the enriched map, the compiler derives one command per screen: the action sequence that reaches it from a clean launch—typically force_stop , launch , followed by a sequence of taps and swipes with fixed coordinates and inter-step waits. A command is executable rather than advisory: replaying it reproduces the recorded trajectory exactly, with no model in the loop. Because the map is obtained purely by exploration and LLM annotation, it can also be rebuilt whenever an app changes. An excerpt of the resulting app map is shown in Figure 6 (Appendix A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 编译为指令。 基于增强后的地图，编译器为每个屏幕生成一条指令：从干净启动状态到达该屏幕的动作序列——通常是 force_stop、launch，随后是一系列具有固定坐标和步骤间等待时间的点击与滑动操作。 指令是可执行的而非建议性的：重放该指令将精确再现记录下的轨迹，过程中无需任何模型介入。 由于地图完全通过探索和大语言模型标注获得，因此当应用发生变动时，也可以重新构建该地图。 生成的应用地图的局部视图展示在图 6（附录 A.2）中。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 is the online counterpart of the compiled command table: given a task, it decides whether a compiled command applies and, if so, executes it reliably. It is deliberately conservative—whenever the mapping is uncertain, the command is declined and the task proceeds to Stage 3.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2 是已编译命令表的在线对应版本：给定一项任务，它会判断是否有已编译的命令适用，如果适用，则可靠地执行该命令。 这一阶段刻意采取了保守策略——只要映射关系存在不确定性，就会拒绝执行该命令，并将任务推进至阶段 3。

paragraphs.en: Command routing. Routing proceeds in two phases, each implemented by a lightweight LLM call. Phase I (selection) presents the task together with a compact command catalog and asks the router to choose among the four decisions defined in Section 2.1 . The catalog is formatted as a prefix tree-commands that share a navigation path are merged at their common prefix and expanded by indentation—so that it remains compact, and it is deliberately symbolic: it carries element paths, semantic tags, and stable operation identifiers, but neither coordinates nor action steps, which keeps it short and prevents the router from inventing device-level actions. A catalog excerpt, together with the router’s output format and an example decision, is shown in Figure 7 (Appendix A.3 ). Phase II (verification) inspects the selected command before any execution: the router judges whether the command’s target screen, described in natural language, is semantically consistent with the task. If it is not, the command is rejected and the task falls back to the VLM, since replaying a plausible but incorrect command would land the VLM on an irrelevant screen and waste the rounds spent recovering.
paragraphs.zh: 命令路由。 路由过程分为两个阶段，每个阶段都由一次轻量级 LLM 调用实现。 第一阶段（选择）会呈现任务以及一个精简的命令目录，并要求路由器从第 2.1 节中定义的四个决策中进行选择。 该目录以前缀树的形式组织：共享导航路径的命令会在其共同前缀处合并，并通过缩进展开——这样既能保持目录的紧凑性，也具有明确的符号意义：它包含元素路径、语义标签和稳定的操作标识符，但不包含坐标或具体动作步骤，从而保持简洁，并防止路由器自行生成设备层面的操作。 一个目录节选，连同路由器的输出格式和一个示例决策，展示在图 7（附录 A.3）中。 第二阶段（验证）会在执行前检查所选命令：路由器会判断该命令的目标屏幕（以自然语言描述）是否在语义上与任务一致。 如果不一致，该命令将被拒绝，任务将回退至 VLM，因为重复执行一个看似合理但错误的命令，会导致 VLM 进入无关的屏幕，并浪费用于恢复的轮次。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic replay and completion. A selected identifier resolves to the command compiled from the map—the model chooses what to do, while the program retains how —so replay requires no perception, incurs no model call, and cannot hallucinate coordinates. Execution is therefore deterministic and completes in sub-second time, in contrast to screen-by-screen navigation, where every step costs seconds and one API call. This is where compilation pays off: navigation, the most repeated part of app use, is removed from the VLM loop entirely. A replayed command is then completed in one of two ways. If the command alone solves the task ( OP ), the agent performs an answerability check on the landed screen and finishes with that answer if it is available; this check differs in kind from the Phase II verification, which asks whether the command’s destination fits the task, whereas this one asks whether the reached screen actually yields the answer. If the answer is not available, the command is demoted to the MACRO_VLM path, so that a command which navigated correctly but cannot answer on its own still saves the VLM the navigation. To avoid a cold start on an unfamiliar screen, the handoff injects a landing hint: the target screen’s natural language description and the list of its interactive elements, together with an explicit note that the command has only navigated to this screen and that the interaction remains to be performed. The hint is cheap—it is drawn from the app map—and turns the apparent teleportation into a warm start.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性重播与完成。 选定的标识符会解析为从地图中编译出的命令——模型决定要做什么，而程序保留其执行方式——因此重播无需感知，也不会触发模型调用，且无法凭空生成坐标。 因此，执行过程是确定性的，并且能在不到一秒的时间内完成，这与逐屏导航形成对比：后者每一步都需要数秒时间并消耗一次 API 调用。 这正是编译发挥作用的地方：导航作为应用程序使用中最频繁的部分，被完全移除了 VLM 循环之外。 随后，重播的命令会通过以下两种方式之一完成。 如果仅凭该命令就能解决任务（OP），智能体会对最终到达的屏幕进行可回答性检查；如果答案可用，则直接以该答案结束。这种检查与第二阶段验证的性质不同：后者判断的是命令的目标位置是否符合任务要求，而前者则判断实际到达的屏幕是否确实能给出答案。 如果答案不可用，该命令会被降级到 MACRO_VLM 路径，这样即使一个命令导航正确但无法自行作答，也能让 VLM 省去导航步骤。 为避免在不熟悉的屏幕上出现冷启动问题，交接过程会注入一个着陆提示：包括目标屏幕的自然语言描述、其交互式元素列表，以及一条明确说明——该命令仅完成了到此屏幕的导航，后续交互仍需执行。 这个提示的成本很低——它直接来自应用地图——并将看似瞬时的跳转转化为一次暖启动。

sents.zh: 这个提示的成本很低——它直接来自应用地图——并将看似瞬时的跳转转化为一次暖启动。

paragraphs.en: Landing check. Replay is not trusted blindly. After execution, the current UI hierarchy is matched against the recorded screens; if the agent has demonstrably landed on a screen unrelated to the command’s target, the app is restarted to a clean state before the VLM takes over, so that a mismatch never silently misleads it. The command is thus verified before replay and checked afterward, which makes the invocation path self-checking and routes every failure to Stage 3. The full invocation path is summarized in Algorithm 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 着陆检查。 回放不会被盲目信任。 执行结束后，当前的 UI 层级结构与记录的画面进行比对；如果智能体明显着陆在与命令目标无关的画面上，应用程序将重启至初始状态，再由 VLM 接管，从而避免不匹配的情况悄无声息地误导它。 因此，命令在回放前得到验证，并在执行后再次检查，这使得调用路径具备自我检查能力，并将所有故障引导至第 3 阶段。 完整的调用路径在算法 1 中进行了总结。

paragraphs.en: Why interpretation is needed. Compilation is inherently partial: the map covers only what exploration could observe, and open-ended interaction cannot be enumerated in advance. Stage 3 therefore interprets what was not compiled. The VLM perceives the screen and acts step by step, following the standard perception—action loop of GUI agents [ 13 , 14 ] ; we write Interpret ​ ( T , h ) \textsc{Interpret}(T,h) for this loop, where the optional h h is the landing hint injected after a replayed navigation.
paragraphs.zh: 为何需要解释。 编译本质上是不完整的：映射仅涵盖探索可能观察到的内容，而开放式的交互无法提前枚举。 因此，阶段 3 会解释未被编译的内容。 VLM 感知屏幕并逐步行动，遵循 GUI 智能体标准的感知—行动循环 [13, 14]；我们将此循环写作 Interpret(T, h) \textsc{Interpret}(T,h)，其中可选的 h 是在重播导航后注入的着陆提示。

paragraphs.en: Memory and recovery. The interpreter maintains a structured state across rounds. Each VLM response ends with a STATE_ASSESSMENT field, and past assessments are injected into the next prompt in chronological order, giving the agent an explicit memory of what it has tried and where it is stuck. On top of this, the loop detects unproductive behavior—repeated scrolling or waiting without screen progress—and injects targeted hints ( e.g. , try the search entry; close the ad overlay). When an action fails at execution time, the error is recorded and re-presented in the next round with a corrective hint. These mechanisms turn the interpreter from a stateless screen actor into a small but self-correcting agent.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆与恢复。 解释器在各轮次之间维持一个结构化状态。 每个 VLM 响应都以一个 STATE_ASSESSMENT 字段结尾，且过往的评估结果会按时间顺序注入到下一个提示中，使智能体明确记住自己尝试过什么以及卡在了哪里。 此外，该循环还能检测无益行为——例如反复滚动或等待而屏幕没有进展——并注入针对性提示（例如：尝试搜索条目；关闭广告覆盖层）。 当某个动作在执行时失败时，错误会被记录并在下一轮中连同纠正提示一并重新呈现。 这些机制将解释器从一个无状态的屏幕操作者转变为一个虽小但能自我修正的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Graceful degradation. The degradation rule is uniform: whenever the compiled path is unavailable, the system runs the pure VLM agent, continuing from the current state, or from a restarted clean state when the landing check has failed. Stage 3 is thus a co-routine rather than a last resort—it is entered by design on every failure of the compiled path, and the interpreter it supplies is exactly the agent that would otherwise have run alone.
paragraphs.zh: 优雅降级。 降级规则是统一的：只要编译后的路径不可用，系统就会运行纯 VLM 智能体，从当前状态继续执行；如果着陆检查失败，则从重启的干净状态开始执行。 因此，阶段 3 是一种协同子程序，而非最后的手段——它会在编译后路径每次失败时按设计进入，而它所提供的解释器正是原本会单独运行的那个智能体。

paragraphs.en: PhoneCLI is an enhancement layer attached to any GUI agent rather than a standalone backbone, so the first question is whether the attachment itself helps. To answer this, Table 1 compares, on three backbones, the full PhoneCLI system against its embedded pure VLM agent ( VLM-only ) — PhoneCLI with the compiled layer removed, all else identical.
paragraphs.zh: PhoneCLI 是一个附加在任何 GUI 智能体上的增强层，而非独立的底层架构，因此第一个问题是：这种附加本身是否有帮助。 为了解答这个问题，表 1 在三种底层架构上，将完整的 PhoneCLI 系统与其中嵌入的纯 VLM 智能体（仅 VLM）进行了比较——即移除了编译层的 PhoneCLI，其他一切保持不变。

sents.en: PhoneCLI is an enhancement layer attached to any GUI agent rather than a standalone backbone, so the first question is whether the attachment itself helps.

sents.en: To answer this, Table 1 compares, on three backbones, the full PhoneCLI system against its embedded pure VLM agent ( VLM-only ) — PhoneCLI with the compiled layer removed, all else identical.
sents.zh: 为了解答这个问题，表 1 在三种底层架构上，将完整的 PhoneCLI 系统与其中嵌入的纯 VLM 智能体（仅 VLM）进行了比较——即移除了编译层的 PhoneCLI，其他一切保持不变。

paragraphs.en: (i) PhoneCLI adapts across backbones, with the largest gains on weaker ones. Attaching PhoneCLI improves the success rate by 12.3 12.3 points on Qwen3.7-Plus and by 0.8 0.8 points on Kimi-K3. Weaker backbones carry limited app-specific navigation knowledge, and the compiled map supplies exactly this missing knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: (i) PhoneCLI 能够适应不同的基础模型，在较弱的模型上表现提升最为显著。 附加 PhoneCLI 后，Qwen3.7-Plus 的成功率提升了 12.3 个点数，而 Kimi-K3 则提升了 0.8 个点数。 较弱的基础模型对特定应用程序的导航知识掌握有限，而编译后的地图恰好提供了这些缺失的知识。

sents.en: (i) PhoneCLI adapts across backbones, with the largest gains on weaker ones.
sents.zh: (i) PhoneCLI 能够适应不同的基础模型，在较弱的模型上表现提升最为显著。

sents.en: Attaching PhoneCLI improves the success rate by 12.3 12.3 points on Qwen3.7-Plus and by 0.8 0.8 points on Kimi-K3.
sents.zh: 附加 PhoneCLI 后，Qwen3.7-Plus 的成功率提升了 12.3 个点数，而 Kimi-K3 则提升了 0.8 个点数。

sents.en: Weaker backbones carry limited app-specific navigation knowledge, and the compiled map supplies exactly this missing knowledge.

paragraphs.en: (ii) Beyond the success-rate gains, tasks are also completed faster and more economically. On Qwen3.7-Plus, PhoneCLI reduces the average number of steps by 11 % 11\% and the token consumption by 14 % 14\% , as deterministic replay replaces multi-round visual navigation with sub-second, zero-token commands.
paragraphs.zh: (ii) 除了成功率有所提升之外，任务完成的速度也更快，成本也更低。 在 Qwen3.7-Plus 上，PhoneCLI 将平均步骤数减少了 11% 11\%，并将令牌消耗量减少了 14% 14\%，因为确定性重播用不到一秒且无需令牌的命令取代了多轮视觉导航。

sents.en: (ii) Beyond the success-rate gains, tasks are also completed faster and more economically.
sents.zh: (ii) 除了成功率有所提升之外，任务完成的速度也更快，成本也更低。

sents.en: On Qwen3.7-Plus, PhoneCLI reduces the average number of steps by 11 % 11\% and the token consumption by 14 % 14\% , as deterministic replay replaces multi-round visual navigation with sub-second, zero-token commands.
sents.zh: 在 Qwen3.7-Plus 上，PhoneCLI 将平均步骤数减少了 11% 11\%，并将令牌消耗量减少了 14% 14\%，因为确定性重播用不到一秒且无需令牌的命令取代了多轮视觉导航。

paragraphs.en: (iii) As backbone capability grows, the success-rate gain shrinks to 0.8 \mathbf{0.8} points on Kimi-K3, while the cost advantage persists — token consumption remains 10 % 10\% lower and the step count remains 5 % 5\% lower. An enhancement layer that keeps reducing cost even when it no longer adds capability is particularly valuable under the latency and cost constraints of mobile deployment.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 situates PhoneCLI against both general-purpose LLMs and GUI-specific models, and two points stand out. First, PhoneCLI lifts a modest backbone toward frontier level: Qwen3.7-Plus (35B) moves from 50.7 as a plain VLM agent to 63.0 with PhoneCLI, closing a 19.2 point gap against the 2.8T-A104B open-weight Kimi-K3 (68.8) to 5.8 points — and on the Kimi backbone itself, PhoneCLI still adds a further 0.8 points (69.6, Table 1 ). A 35B model enhanced by PhoneCLI is thus brought within reach of a 2.8T-class one, demonstrating the strong amplification PhoneCLI provides for weaker models. Notably, 63.0 is also above every GUI-specific model in Table 2 , even though those models are trained for GUI control while PhoneCLI is not.
paragraphs.zh: 表2将PhoneCLI与通用型LLM和GUI专用模型进行了对比，其中有两点尤为突出。 首先，PhoneCLI使一个中等规模的基模达到了前沿水平：Qwen3.7-Plus（35B）作为普通VLM智能体时得分为50.7，而使用PhoneCLI后得分提升至63.0，与2.8T-A104B开源模型Kimi-K3（68.8）的差距从19.2分缩小至5.8分——即便在Kimi基模本身的基础上，PhoneCLI仍进一步提升了0.8分（69.6，见表1）。 因此，经过PhoneCLI增强的35B模型性能已接近2.8T级别的模型，这证明了PhoneCLI对较弱模型具有显著的增强效果。 值得注意的是，63.0这一分数也高于表2中所有GUI专用模型，尽管这些模型是专为GUI控制而训练的，而PhoneCLI并非如此。

paragraphs.en: Second, the two PhoneCLI rows preview where the gain comes from. PhoneCLI w/o replay keeps the app map but removes the replay mechanism: the map is only injected as reference text, and the VLM must navigate screens on its own. Information injection alone lifts Qwen3.7-Plus from 50.7 to 55.1, while adding deterministic replay raises it further to 63.0 — the replay step contributes the larger share of the gain. This shows that PhoneCLI’s improvement is not merely from exposing map information to the VLM, but substantially from a dedicated design: executing that knowledge deterministically, without VLM involvement. Moreover, App. A.4 reports a generalization test in which our method is attached to the official AndroidWorld agent.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，PhoneCLI 的两行结果预览展示了性能提升的来源。不含重播的 PhoneCLI 保留了应用地图，但移除了重播机制：地图仅作为参考文本注入，而 VLM 必须自行完成屏幕导航。仅通过信息注入，Qwen3.7-Plus 的性能就从 50.7 提升到了 55.1；而加入确定性重播后，性能进一步提升至 63.0——重播步骤贡献了性能提升的主要部分。这表明 PhoneCLI 的改进并非仅仅源于向 VLM 暴露地图信息，而是主要得益于其专门的设计：即在不涉及 VLM 的情况下，以确定性方式执行该知识。此外，附录 A.4 报告了一项泛化测试，其中我们的方法被集成到了官方的 AndroidWorld 智能体中。

paragraphs.en: We conduct ablations at two granularities: (I) how much each of PhoneCLI ’s two core components contributes—the compiled map used as information and deterministic replay—and (I) whether any individual mechanism within these components is dispensable. We study both questions on AndroidLab using Qwen3.7-Plus across nine apps.

paragraphs.en: (I) Core decomposition. Three conditions decompose PhoneCLI’s stack along its modules. w/o map (VLM only) removes the compiled map together with its replay machinery, leaving Stage 3, the pure VLM agent, at 50.7%. w/o replay keeps the map but only as information, injecting its navigation reference into the VLM’s prompt, at 55.1% ( + 4.4 +4.4 ). PhoneCLI additionally executes matched commands deterministically, at 63.0% ( + 7.9 +7.9 ). Both components pay off, replay the more.

paragraphs.en: Cost and coupling. Injection shortens navigation but leaves the VLM in the loop: every remaining round still re-reads the injected reference and still pays a full VLM call, so rounds fall while tokens stay flat (7.52 → \rightarrow 6.95; 40.1k → \rightarrow 39.6k). Replay removes the call itself — compiled navigation consumes no VLM call — and collapses a multi-step traversal into a single recorded operation (6.95 → \rightarrow 6.72; 34.4k, − 13 % -13\% ). The rounds that remain are the actual interaction rather than navigation. All efficiency numbers average over each condition’s own successful tasks (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 成本与耦合。 注入缩短了导航过程，但 VLM 仍持续参与：每个剩余的回合仍需重新读取已注入的参考信息，并支付完整的 VLM 调用费用，因此回合数减少，而令牌数保持不变（7.52 → \rightarrow 6.95；40.1k → \rightarrow 39.6k）。 重播移除了调用本身——编译后的导航不消耗任何 VLM 调用——并将多步骤遍历压缩为一次记录的操作（6.95 → \rightarrow 6.72；34.4k，− 13 % -13\%）。 剩余的回合代表实际的交互，而非导航。 所有效率数值均基于每种条件下各自成功完成的任务进行平均计算（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Failure modes. Figure 2 orders the nine apps by how much the injected information contributes, and the ordering is uneven: injection helps on some apps and hurts on others. Its failure mode is that every screen must pass through the model’s understanding, so it degrades exactly where the map is semantically sparse or noisy — which is what collapses Calendar to 0/14. Replay has no understanding step and recovers the same app to 4/14, but it executes the command as recorded, so a wrong landing is silent and only a post-replay check can catch it.
paragraphs.zh: 失效模式。 图 2 根据注入信息对九个应用的影响程度进行了排序，且排序并不均匀：注入信息在某些应用中有帮助，而在另一些应用中则产生负面影响。 其失效模式在于每个屏幕都必须经过模型的理解环节，因此当地图在语义上稀疏或存在噪声时，性能会恰好在此处下降——这正是日历应用得分降至 0/14 的原因。 重播没有理解环节，能将同一应用恢复至 4/14 的水平，但它会按照记录执行命令，因此错误的落地操作不会有任何提示，只有通过重播后的检查才能发现。

paragraphs.en: (II) Fine-grained mechanisms. Every variant in Table 3 removes one mechanism, and every removal costs at least 12 success-rate points. On the map side , element classification — the STABLE / DYNAMIC annotation the router uses to tell version-persistent elements from transient ones — is the costliest single removal ( − 15.9 % -15.9\% ), and semantic enrichment, the aliases and page descriptions that make the structural graph routable to both the router and the verifier, costs nearly as much ( − 15.2 % -15.2\% ). On the replay side , the landing check verifies that replay actually reached the target screen; without it, wrong landings silently mislead the VLM onto irrelevant screens ( − 12.3 % -12.3\% ). The landing hint — the description and element list injected at handoff — keeps a teleported VLM from starting cold ( − 13.0 % -13.0\% ). Command completion lets the OP path finish a replay-only task in one deterministic replay and one verification, with no VLM interaction at all; forcing such tasks through the VLM wastes that and adds risk ( − 14.4 % -14.4\% ).
paragraphs.zh: （II）精细机制。 表3中的每个变体都移除了一个机制，而每次移除至少会损失12个成功率积分。 在地图方面，元素分类——即路由器用来区分版本持久元素与临时元素的“稳定/动态”标注——是单次移除中成本最高的（−15.9%），而语义增强，即使结构图对路由器和验证器均可导航的别名与页面描述，其成本也几乎同样高（−15.2%）。 在重播方面，着陆检查用于验证重播是否确实到达了目标屏幕；若缺少这一检查，错误的着陆会悄无声息地误导VLM，使其进入无关屏幕（−12.3%）。 着陆提示——即移交时注入的描述和元素列表——可防止被传送的VLM从头开始运行（−13.0%）。 命令完成功能允许OP路径通过一次确定性重播和一次验证来完成仅适用于重播的任务，而无需任何与VLM的交互；若强制此类任务经过VLM，则会浪费这一优势并增加风险（−14.4%）。

paragraphs.en: Across both ablation resolutions, we reach the same conclusion: map information and deterministic replay contribute complementarily, and no single mechanism can be removed. Because each variant is evaluated against the full PhoneCLI system, the observed performance drops do not partition the overall gain; instead, multiple components independently account for improvements beyond the VLM-only baseline gap, indicating that each mechanism is load-bearing.
paragraphs.zh: 在两种消融分辨率下，我们都得出了相同的结论：地图信息和确定性重播相互补充，缺一不可。 由于每个变体都是基于完整的 PhoneCLI 系统进行评估的，因此观察到的性能下降并未分割整体增益；相反，多个组件各自独立地带来了超越仅使用 VLM 的基线差距之外的提升，这表明每个机制都起着关键作用。

paragraphs.en: The ablation above removes components; another complementary question is how much to build : what budget should the offline crawler be given, and is a larger map always better? We vary the screen budget of map construction on two representative apps — Setting (native Android UI) and Clock (moderate complexity) — and report success rates in Figure 3 .

sents.en: We vary the screen budget of map construction on two representative apps — Setting (native Android UI) and Clock (moderate complexity) — and report success rates in Figure 3 .
sents.zh: 我们在两款代表性应用——设置（原生 Android 用户界面）和时钟（中等复杂度）——上调整了地图构建的屏幕预算，并在图 3 中报告了成功率。

paragraphs.en: Two patterns stand out. First , both apps exhibit an inverted-U: success rises as the budget grows from 10 to 50 screens, then drops at 100. Setting climbs from 87.0% to 95.7% and falls to 78.3%; Clock climbs from 63.0% to 77.8% and falls to 66.7%. Second , the two ends of the curve fail for different reasons. A small map under-covers the app: more tasks find no matching command and fall back to the VLM, forfeiting the compiled layer. An oversized map inflates the command catalog — from roughly 130 tokens at 10 screens to 3.5k at 100 — so Phase I must choose among a far larger, noisier candidate set, and mis-routing becomes more likely: the compiled layer then actively hurts. The default budget of 50 lands on the peak, which is also why the sweet spot is app-dependent rather than universal. Compression is thus not merely a cost measure but a prerequisite for routing accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个模式尤为突出。 首先，两款应用都呈现出倒U形曲线：当预算从10个屏幕增加到50个屏幕时，成功率会上升，但在达到100个屏幕时则会下降。 Setting的成功率从87.0%升至95.7%，随后降至78.3%；Clock的成功率则从63.0%升至77.8%，之后降至66.7%。 其次，曲线两端的失败原因各不相同。 地图过小会导致应用覆盖不足：更多任务找不到匹配的命令，转而依赖VLM，从而失去了编译层带来的优势。 地图过大则会膨胀命令目录——从10个屏幕时的约130个token增至100个屏幕时的3.5k——因此第一阶段必须从更大、更嘈杂的候选集中进行选择，导致错误路由的可能性增加：此时编译层反而会带来负面影响。 默认的50个屏幕预算正好处于峰值位置，这也是为什么最佳参数因应用而异，而非普适性的原因。 因此，压缩不仅是一种成本衡量手段，更是确保路由准确性的前提条件。

paragraphs.en: The net drop of 17 failures (68 → \rightarrow 51) splits into 27 saved and 10 lost. The losses are mostly routing cost — two tasks mis-judged as command-only and four that landed on mismatched screens or failed the form interaction afterwards — plus four containing no macro at all, which are single-run VLM variance. The saved 27 span all four modes — looping 16, premature finish 1, execution 6, grounding 4 — which is the key finding: the compiled layer repairs no single failure mode, it prevents the search for the entry point . Once a command lands the VLM on the right screen, whole classes of failure lose their occasion. Grounding is the cleanest case: all four VLM-only grounding failures are saved, and the two that remain under PhoneCLI are single-run variance rather than mis-routing, since replay neither taps the wrong element nor is misled by semantics. Execution and other failures lose six, driven by fewer abnormal aborts — deterministic replay does not crash the way step-by-step interaction does — and fewer pattern-less exhaustions, as macros save rounds.

paragraphs.en: GUI agents for mobile devices largely adopt the perception-action paradigm: each step observes the screen and emits an indexed or coordinate-level action, with the underlying competence acquired through training. One line of work trains vision-language backbones for GUI grounding — perceiving screens and localizing elements [ 31 , 32 ] ; another specializes models for task completion through supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, including AutoGLM [ 1 ] , MobileRL [ 2 ] , MobileUse [ 3 ] , UI-Genie-Agent [ 28 ] , UI-Tars [ 29 ] , and V-Droid [ 30 ] . Surveys consolidate this paradigm [ 4 , 33 ] . Because capability lives in the weights, a new app demands new data or re-training — a bottleneck studied directly in recent work on RL generalization [ 11 ] and unseen-app adaptation [ 12 ] . Orthogonal to this, a second line augments the GUI loop with programmatic execution: agents that write and execute code [ 5 ] , API-based computer use over instrumented applications [ 6 ] , and mobile harnesses that mix GUI with device-side commands [ 8 ] . All of these assume an execution surface already exists — an OS that runs code, apps that expose APIs, or system-level CLI access. PhoneCLI takes the opposite stance: it synthesizes that surface by compiling an app’s GUI navigation into callable commands, needing no API, no instrumentation, and no training, while keeping the perception-action loop only as a fallback.
paragraphs.zh: 移动设备的 GUI 智能体主要采用感知-行动范式：每一步都会观察屏幕并输出一个索引或坐标级别的行动，其底层能力则通过训练获得。 一类研究为 GUI 定位训练视觉-语言主干模型——即感知屏幕并定位元素 [31, 32]；另一类则通过监督微调或强化学习，专门训练模型以完成任务，包括 AutoGLM [1]、MobileRL [2]、MobileUse [3]、UI-Genie-Agent [28]、UI-Tars [29] 和 V-Droid [30]。 综述研究整合了这一范式 [4, 33]。 由于能力存在于模型权重中，因此新应用需要新的数据或重新训练——这一瓶颈在近期关于强化学习泛化性 [11] 和未见应用适应性的研究 [12] 中被直接探讨。 与此独立地，第二类研究通过程序化执行来增强 GUI 循环：能够编写和执行代码的智能体 [5]、基于 API 的计算机操作（针对已植入监测工具的应用）[6]，以及将 GUI 与设备端命令相结合的移动控制框架 [8]。 所有这些方法都假设已经存在一个执行环境——即能够运行代码的操作系统、提供 API 的应用程序，或系统级别的命令行接口访问权限。 PhoneCLI 采取了相反的立场：它通过将应用的 GUI 导航编译为可调用命令来合成这一执行环境，无需 API、无需监测工具，也无需训练，同时仅将感知-行动循环作为备用方案保留。

paragraphs.en: The idea of systematically traversing an app to learn its structure goes back to Android GUI testing crawlers [ 21 , 22 ] , which optimize coverage and crash discovery rather than agent performance. Recent work reorients exploration toward agents, and diverges by what the explored structure becomes. In the first line, exploration yields knowledge to read : AppAgent [ 34 ] writes natural-language operation documents; AutoDroid [ 35 ] turns UI transitions into executable scripts; GUI-explorer [ 17 ] mines function-aware trajectories; GUI-Xplore [ 18 ] packages exploration videos into a generalization dataset; and RAG-GUI [ 36 ] retrieves web tutorials at inference time. In every case the model consumes the knowledge, yet still performs each action itself. In the second line, exploration yields graph guidance : UI-KOBE [ 16 ] builds an app knowledge graph offline and lets a lightweight agent navigate by matching its current screen to graph nodes and choosing among their transitions — the agent stays in the loop, steered but not replaced. In the third line, exploration yields replay programs : PreAct [ 15 ] compiles a successful agent run into a state-machine program online, so that repeating the same task replays instead of re-reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 系统遍历应用程序以了解其结构这一理念可追溯至 Android GUI 测试爬虫 [21, 22]，它们优化的是覆盖率和崩溃检测，而非智能体的性能。 近期的研究将探索方向重新转向智能体，并根据所探索的结构演变为不同的形式。 在第一行中，探索产生的知识可供读取：AppAgent [34] 会编写自然语言操作文档；AutoDroid [35] 将 UI 转换转为可执行脚本；GUI-explorer [17] 挖掘具备功能意识的轨迹；GUI-Xplore [18] 将探索视频打包成泛化数据集；而 RAG-GUI [36] 则会在推理时检索网络教程。 在所有这些情况下，模型都会利用这些知识，但仍需自行执行每一项操作。 在第二行中，探索产生的知识是图引导：UI-KOBE [16] 会离线构建应用程序知识图谱，并让轻量级智能体通过将当前屏幕与图谱节点匹配、从节点间的转换中选择路径来进行导航——智能体仍留在流程中，仅受引导而非被替代。 在第三行中，探索产生的知识是重播程序：PreAct [15] 会将一次成功的智能体运行在线编译为状态机程序，这样重复执行相同任务时，系统会进行重播而非重新推理。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose PhoneCLI to address the lack of mobile app programmatic interfaces. We compile the static, repetitive portion of navigation offline into deterministic, zero-VLM commands and replay the matched command online in sub-second time; open-ended interaction and any compilation failures fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter. On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves task success rate while reducing step and token costs, yielding a stronger agent at lower cost.

sents.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 PhoneCLI，以解决移动应用程序编程接口缺失的问题。

sents.en: We compile the static, repetitive portion of navigation offline into deterministic, zero-VLM commands and replay the matched command online in sub-second time; open-ended interaction and any compilation failures fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter.
sents.zh: 我们将导航中静态且重复的部分离线编译为确定性的零 VLM 命令，并在在线时以亚秒级时间重放匹配的命令；对于开放式交互和任何编译失败的情况，则回退到嵌入式 VLM 解释器。

sents.en: On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves task success rate while reducing step and token costs, yielding a stronger agent at lower cost.
sents.zh: 在 AndroidLab 上，PhoneCLI 提高了任务成功率，同时减少了步骤和令牌成本，从而以更低的成本获得了更强大的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Our maps are built offline, once per app, and reused across every task and every condition. Starting from the app’s home screen, a breadth-first crawler explores up to 50 screens to a depth of 3, scrolling each list up to three pages; the only app-specific input is the package name, so no per-app engineering is involved. Each discovered screen is annotated with the text, normalized center, and semantic aliases of its elements, together with the navigation edges it exposes. Across the nine AndroidLab apps the resulting maps contain 320 screens, 2,822 elements, and 1,089 navigation edges, which compile into 2,017 operations (891 navigation and 1,126 action). Building one map takes on the order of ten minutes on a single emulator and runs entirely offline, consuming no rounds or tokens of any evaluated agent. Crucially, construction observes only the app itself: it never reads task instructions, target states, or evaluation code. All variants share the same maps, and the PhoneCLI w/o replay variant receives the same map serialized as a navigation catalog, without macro replay.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的地图是离线构建的，每个应用只构建一次，并在所有任务和所有条件下重复使用。 从应用的首页开始，一个广度优先爬虫会探索最多 50 个屏幕，深度为 3，每个列表最多滚动三页；唯一的应用特定输入是包名，因此无需针对每个应用进行工程开发。 每个发现的屏幕都会标注其元素的文本、归一化中心位置和语义别名，以及它提供的导航边。 在九个 AndroidLab 应用中，生成的地图包含 320 个屏幕、2,822 个元素和 1,089 条导航边，这些可编译为 2,017 次操作（891 次导航和 1,126 次动作）。 在单个模拟器上构建一张地图大约需要十分钟，且整个过程完全离线运行，不会消耗任何被评估智能体的轮次或令牌。 关键在于，构建过程仅观察应用本身：它从不读取任务说明、目标状态或评估代码。 所有变体共享相同的地图，而“无重播”的 PhoneCLI 变体则会收到以导航目录形式序列化的相同地图，但不包含宏重播。

paragraphs.en: Operation tasks are judged by programmatic XML checkers and query tasks by an LLM judge; all conditions are re-judged under one unified judge model (Qwen3.7-Plus) to keep cross-model comparisons free of judge bias. Of the 138 tasks, 94 are graded by deterministic checkers over the final screen XML and the remaining 44 are query-style tasks graded by an LLM judge. Because different agents terminate in different states, we re-grade the logs of every condition with a single unified judge, so that the reported differences reflect the agents rather than the metric. All runs use an Android 13 emulator (Pixel 7 Pro AVD, 1440 × 3120 1440\times 3120 ); the emulator is cold-booted once and a clean snapshot is restored before every task, so tasks never observe each other’s state. Each task is attempted once under a cap of 25 rounds. Success rate is computed over all 138 tasks, whereas step and token counts are averaged over each condition’s successful tasks and therefore measure the cost of a successful trajectory. The gains of our methods over the strongest baseline in Table 1 and Table 2 are statistically significant ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
paragraphs.zh: 操作任务由程序化的 XML 检查器进行判断，查询任务则由 LLM 判断器进行判断；所有条件均通过统一的判断模型（Qwen3.7-Plus）重新判断，以确保跨模型比较不受判断偏差的影响。 在 138 个任务中，有 94 个任务由确定性检查器根据最终屏幕的 XML 进行评分，其余 44 个为查询类任务，由 LLM 判断器进行评分。 由于不同智能体以不同状态终止，我们使用单一的统一判断器重新评估所有条件的日志，以确保报告出的差异反映的是智能体本身，而非评估指标。 所有运行均使用 Android 13 模拟器（Pixel 7 Pro AVD，1440 × 3120 1440\times 3120）；模拟器仅冷启动一次，并在每个任务前恢复干净的快照，因此各任务不会观察到彼此的状态。 每个任务在最多 25 轮的限制下尝试一次。 成功率基于全部 138 个任务计算，而步骤和令牌数量则对每个条件下的成功任务取平均值，因此衡量的是成功轨迹的成本。 我们的方法相较于表 1 和表 2 中最强的基线方法所取得的提升具有统计学显著性（ p < 0.05 p<0.05 ）。

paragraphs.en: Observations follow the set-of-mark convention [ 37 ] : interactable elements are drawn with numeric tags, and the model acts on those tags. All backbones are used off the shelf without fine-tuning, at temperature 0 and at most 512 new tokens per call; Qwen3.7-Plus is our default, and we additionally report runs with GLM-4.6V and Kimi-K3. Every condition shares the same observation format, prompt template, action space, and backbone, and conditions differ only in what is injected into the model’s context, which isolates the effect of compiled commands. Executing a compiled operation issues ADB commands directly and invokes no model call. Token usage is accounted by call labels: agent_vlm for the interpreter loop of Section 2.4 , macro_map_task for the Phase I routing call of Section 2.3 , and macro_verify for its Phase II verification; judge calls are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 观察遵循“集合标记”约定 [ 37 ]：可交互元素以数字标签绘制，模型则根据这些标签采取行动。 所有基础模型均直接现成使用，未经微调，温度设为 0，每次调用最多生成 512 个新标记；Qwen3.7-Plus 是我们的默认模型，此外我们还报告了使用 GLM-4.6V 和 Kimi-K3 的运行结果。 每个条件都共享相同的观察格式、提示模板、动作空间和基础模型，条件的差异仅在于注入模型上下文的内容，从而隔离了编译命令的影响。 执行编译后的操作会直接发出 ADB 命令，不会触发任何模型调用。 标记使用量通过调用标签进行统计：agent_vlm 用于第 2.4 节的解释器循环，macro_map_task 用于第 2.3 节的第一阶段路由调用，macro_verify 用于其第二阶段的验证；judge 调用不计入统计。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows what an app map stores; this section describes the second half of Stage 1, which turns those records into the command catalog 𝒞 \mathcal{C} that the Stage 2 router reads, and illustrates the one-line interface the router answers with.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 展示了应用地图所存储的内容；本节将描述阶段 1 的后半部分，即如何将这些记录转换为命令目录 𝒞 \mathcal{C}（由阶段 2 的路由器读取），并说明路由器会以此提供单行接口进行响应。

paragraphs.en: Compiling commands. The compiler walks the screen graph from the home screen and, for every interactive element, emits one operation : the element path that leads to it (for example Connected devices → \rightarrow Pair new device ) paired with the action sequence that produces it, namely the macro of the parent screen, followed by the scroll steps needed to bring the element into view, followed by a tap at its recorded center. Operations whose element navigates to another screen are marked nav ; the remainder are terminal actions ( act ) such as toggles and text fields. Because several element paths may reach the same screen, an operation is keyed by its path , not by its destination: the catalog lists one entry per path, and only the path along which a screen was first expanded carries that screen’s own children.
paragraphs.zh: 正在编译命令。 编译器从主屏幕开始遍历屏幕图，并对每个交互式元素生成一个操作：该元素的访问路径（例如“已连接设备”→\rightarrow“配对新设备”），以及生成该元素的动作序列，即父屏幕的宏命令，接着是使该元素进入视野所需的滚动步骤，最后是点击其记录的中心位置。 元素导航至另一屏幕的操作会被标记为 nav；其余操作则为终端动作（act），例如切换按钮和文本字段。 由于多个元素路径可能到达同一屏幕，因此操作的键由路径而非目的地决定：目录中每条路径仅对应一个条目，且只有最初展开该屏幕的路径会携带该屏幕自身的子元素。

paragraphs.en: Rendering the catalog. Because the catalog is re-sent on every routing call, its size is a recurring cost, so we compress it aggressively. The router only has to decide where to go, so the catalog lists navigation operations only: for Settings this reduces 288 operations to 98 nav entries in 9 groups, and the rendered catalog from roughly 6.2k to 1.9k tokens. Entries sharing a common path prefix are merged into a tree, so a shared navigation prefix is written once and children are indented. Each line carries the element text, its semantic type, one of its aliases, and a stable operation id — a slug of its element path, truncated at 60 characters — which is the only thing the router has to output.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染目录。 由于每次路由调用都会重新发送目录，其大小会持续产生成本，因此我们对其进行大幅压缩。 路由器只需决定前往何处，因此目录仅列出导航操作：对于“设置”，此举将 288 个操作减少为 9 组中的 98 个导航条目，渲染后的目录也从约 6.2k 缩减至 1.9k 个词元。 共享公共路径前缀的条目会被合并为一棵树结构，因此共享的导航前缀只需写入一次，子项则通过缩进表示。 每行包含元素文本、其语义类型、其中一个别名以及一个稳定的操作 ID——即其元素路径的简短标识符（截断至 60 个字符）——而路由器只需输出这一部分信息。

paragraphs.en: From catalog to action. The router answers in a single line with one of four decisions ( op , macro_vlm , need_vlm , finish ); the selected id resolves to the macro compiled above, which is replayed with fixed coordinates and no model call. For example, for the task “pair a new Bluetooth device” the router answers MACRO_VLM: settings_connected_devices_pair_new_device and the system replays force_stop ∣ \mid launch ∣ \mid tap(548,1428) ∣ \mid tap(496,874) before handing control to the VLM on the Bluetooth page. The catalog is compiled once per app and cached, so this interface costs one prefix of a single routing call per task, and it is plain text: it can be inspected, edited, or reused across models.
paragraphs.zh: 从目录到行动。 路由器以单行回复，给出四种决策之一（op、macro_vlm、need_vlm、finish）；所选 ID 会解析为上述编译好的宏，该宏将以固定坐标播放且不会调用模型。 例如，对于“配对新蓝牙设备”这项任务，路由器会回复 MACRO_VLM: settings_connected_devices_pair_new_device，系统则会先强制停止 ∣ \mid 启动 ∣ \mid 点击(548,1428) ∣ \mid 点击(496,874)，然后将控制权移交至蓝牙页面的 VLM。 目录按应用编译一次并缓存，因此该接口每项任务仅需一次路由调用的前缀开销，且为纯文本格式：可以查看、编辑或跨模型重复使用。

sents.en: The catalog is compiled once per app and cached, so this interface costs one prefix of a single routing call per task, and it is plain text: it can be inspected, edited, or reused across models.

paragraphs.en: PhoneCLI is an enhancement layer, and the strongest test of that claim is whether it helps an agent it was not designed for. We therefore attach the compiled layer to M3A — the Multimodal Autonomous Agent and official baseline of AndroidWorld [ 20 ] , which acts step by step on annotated screenshots — by subclassing it and adding only the map-based routing of Section 2.3 . M3A’s prompts, action space, and perception remain untouched, and when routing declines, execution proceeds exactly as the original M3A. Both agents run on Qwen3.7-Plus.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 reports the results. The map-augmented agent scores higher than the original M3A agent. And the efficiency gains are consistent and substantial: 9% fewer tokens overall, and on the 70 tasks both agents solve, 7.7 steps versus 8.4. That these savings transfer to a different benchmark, a different agent framework, and an untouched M3A shows the compiled layer’s efficiency does not depend on any AndroidLab-specific design. M3A is already a mature agent, and on this backbone the enhancement approaches the ceiling of what Qwen3.7-Plus can achieve — what remains to gain is efficiency rather than capability. Across environments, the enhancement-layer claim of our method therefore holds.
paragraphs.zh: 表4报告了相关结果。 经过地图增强的智能体得分高于原始M3A智能体。 而且效率提升既稳定又显著：整体令牌使用量减少了9%，在两个智能体共同解决的70项任务中，步骤数从8.4降至7.7。 这些节省效果能够迁移到不同的基准测试、不同的智能体框架以及未经修改的M3A上，表明编译层的效率并不依赖于任何AndroidLab特定的设计。 M3A本身已经是一个成熟的智能体，在这一基础架构上，增强效果已接近Qwen3.7-Plus所能达到的上限——接下来需要提升的是效率，而非能力。 因此，我们的方法在跨环境中的增强层主张是成立的。
